*Part of the [ASA-DahShu Master Protocol Working Group](mpwg.qmd).*

## Overview

The Methodology and Concept sub-stream focuses on the theoretical and applied foundations of master protocol design, including framework development, estimand considerations, simulation methodology, and the conceptual distinctions between basket, umbrella, and platform trial structures.

**Co-leads:** Bryan McComb, Ph.D. (Pfizer) and Courtney Henry, Ph.D. (GSK)

This sub-stream is undergoing a reboot under new leadership. New members are actively welcome.

## Current Focus Areas

- Developing a unified framework for classifying and comparing master protocol design types
- Simulation methodology for evaluating operating characteristics of basket and platform designs
- Estimand considerations specific to master protocol contexts
- Methodological guidance on borrowing of information across sub-studies

## Recent Activity

The sub-stream contributed to the multidisciplinary MPWG book (*Master Protocol Clinical Trial for Efficient Evidence Generation*, nearing publication) and is preparing manuscripts on master protocol methodology targeting *Contemporary Clinical Trials*.
